nodes.speaker: Seila
nodes.text: Courts failed, scripted. So we go around: Evelor's poll, three pulses, one million voices. Then Lektor walks out of lockdown.

nodes.speaker: Evelor
nodes.text: Poll won. Now the unglamorous part: walk Lektor out through his own lockdown. Then choose what Thaldur becomes.

nodes.speaker: Gladias
nodes.text: Thaldur opens. Water thaws and merges — or ice preserves and splits?

nodes.speaker: Lektor
nodes.text: Continuity, not purge. The structure holds — with new hands on it.

hints: Three pulses, 1M target. Safe stakes total 600k — you must go loud at least once.
Lockdown is lethal and timed. The rock at (4,5) is your only weapon.
Trace doesn't matter anymore. Speed does.
